subject: Live validation: OTLP -> Datadog intake (proposed sprint / test plan)
messages:
From: Maria Lara <maria.lara@datadog.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: 90-min live validation (OTLP export -> Datadog intake)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — I’m Maria on the Datadog Solutions team. We’d like to run a focused live validation with Redwood to exercise the OTLP export path into Datadog and verify our joint observability story end-to-end. The goal is to validate trace/metric/log linkage, ingestion latency at elevated QPS, and TLS/API-key rotation behavior.

Proposed format (90 minutes):
- 15m: context + success criteria (roles, accounts, and safety guardrails)
- 45m: live traffic run (gradual ramp to target QPS, sampling toggles)
- 20m: shortpost-mortem + next steps (mutual action items, Docs/PRs)

What we need from you pre-run:
- A short checklist with OTLP config you’ll use (OTLP exporter version, endpoint, TLS profile)
- A temporary test API key or a Datadog test org we can post events to
- Any network constraints (eg egress IP allowlist, proxy)

I’m attaching a small validation template (dd-validation-template.xlsx) that we typically use to collect targets and thresholds.

Are you available the week of May 17th? If so we can lock a slot and share the runbook/link to a recording lab.

Thanks,
Maria
Maria Lara | Solutions Engineer, Integrations
Datadog
Attachment: dd-validation-template.xlsx (xlsx)

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear outline. We’re keen to run this. Week of May 17 works for us; preferred window is May 18–20 in the US morning (PST).

Quick answers and asks:
- We’ll be using our staging cluster with the OTLP exporter; Laura (cc’d) will own the config.
- For keys: we prefer a short-lived test API key you can create for the run; if not possible, a dedicated test org would work.
- Network: outbound to datadog intake over TCP 443; no corporate proxy in the staging path.

Can you share your acceptance criteria matrix (SLA/loss thresholds) ahead of time so we can shape the load script? I’ll draft a mutual action plan and drop a doc link and a HubSpot ticket (HS-00087293) for tracking.

Thanks — looping in Laura and Ben to own the tech runbooks.

—Karthik

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lara <maria.lara@datadog.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-10T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: 90-min live validation (OTLP export -> Datadog intake)

Hi Maria / Karthik — I put together a short technical runbook and checklist for the live validation. Attaching a copy of the redwood OTLP config we’ll deploy and a small load script we’ll use to exercise traces/metrics.

High-level checklist (please confirm on your side):
- OTLP exporter version: open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector v0.58.0 (we’ll pin in the staging helm chart)
- Endpoint: https://intake.datadoghq.com/v1/otlp (TLS mutual not in use for this run)
- API key: short-lived key created by Datadog; we’ll rotate immediately after the test
- Sampling: start with 100% traces for the first 2 minutes, then move to target sampling of 5% for sustained ramp
- Expected QPS target: 1,000 spans/s sustained for 10 minutes, spike to 5,000 spans/s for 90s as stress test
- KV cache warm-up: ensure new model/prefix cache is warmed for 5 minutes prior to load (to avoid backend cold-starts affecting latency)
- Observability SLOs we’ll measure: p50/p95/p99 ingest latency, span loss rate, partial payload errors (4xx/5xx)
- Data retention / PII: no production PII will be included in test payloads; we’ll use synthetic IDs

Attachments included: redwood-otlp-config.txt, load-script.sh

If Datadog can confirm the intake capacity and an API key by EOD Friday (May 14), we’ll schedule the run for May 18 at 10:00 AM PST and share a Zoom + runbook.

Laura Bennett
Senior Technical Program Manager, Integrations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-otlp-config.txt (text)
Attachment: load-script.sh (bash)

From: Maria Lara <maria.lara@datadog.com>

Thanks Laura — this is perfect. Confirming the following: 
- We created a temporary test API key: TEST-KEY-9X7 (will expire 48 hours after the run).
- Intake capacity: we can support the proposed spike pattern on your staging org (we’ll monitor from the Datadog side).
- Acceptance thresholds we’ll validate: 
  * span loss < 0.2% during steady-state
  * p95 ingest latency < 350ms
  * error rate (4xx/5xx) < 0.5%

I’ve uploaded a short runbook and a shared doc (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-datadog-redwood-live-test) and updated the HubSpot ticket HS-00087293 with the schedule (May 18 10:00 AM PST).

I’ll send calendar invites and the Zoom link shortly. Looking forward to it.

Onwards,
Maria
